pages.text: The Processor upgrades "energy liquids" into "fuel liquids", two recipes:$(li)$(bold)Nether Compound Fuel$(0): 1 solid + 1000 mb Nether Compound Energy → 1000 mb, 5M per batch$(li)$(bold)Pure Fuel$(0): 1 solid + 100 mb Nether Pure Energy → 75 mb — light concentration that sips solids$(br2)Pure Fuel is small, but it is one of the Mixer's top-tier ingredients — don't skip the concentration step.

$(bold)How to run it:$(0) one recipe at a time; switching materials wipes the progress, so pick one line and run it to the end.$(br2)Which line:$(li)volume first: Nether Compound Fuel, a straight 1:1 deal$(li)purity first: Pure Fuel, feeding the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l) for Ultimate Mixture$(br2)Run either into the $(l:akaishi:fuel_canner)Fuel Canner$(/l) and it heads to the Reactor as canned fuel.
Feedstock comes from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_liquefier)Energy Liquefier$(/l); if you'd rather blend fuel up a tier, see $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).
